title: Yachts and Boats Business for Sale in Alappuzha, India
tagline: Luxury fully furnished one-bedroom houseboat operating in the Alappuzha backwaters, offering backwater cruises and overnight stays for leisure tourists. - The houseboat is fully air-conditioned and has a passenger capacity of up to 15 people, with dining facilities onboard. - The business has been operating for 9 years and primarily serves leisure tourists visiting the Alappuzha backwaters. - The average room tariff is approximately INR 22,000 per night for double occupancy. - The business receives approximately 24+ bookings per month through direct bookings and travel agents. - Some future bookings are available to be transferred to the buyer as part of the transaction. - The houseboat was last serviced approximately 3 months ago and has no reported legal or regulatory issues. - The existing crew will not continue after the sale, allowing the buyer to appoint their own operating team. - All registrations and licenses under the Kerala Maritime Board/KIV regulations are valid, with docking rights and permits transferable to the buyer.
